title.en: Chapter 11 — What I Heard in the Apple Barrel

sentences.en: On a quiet night, I wanted an apple.

sentences.ar: نزلت جوا برميل التفاح ونمت شوي.
sentences.en: I climbed inside the apple barrel and slept a little.

sentences.ar: صحيت على صوت سيلفر جنب البرميل.
sentences.en: I woke to Silver’s voice beside the barrel.
He was talking with a young sailor.

sentences.ar: قال: لما نلاقي الكنز، بنقتلهم كلهم.
sentences.en: He said: when we find the treasure, we kill them all.

sentences.ar: ضلّيت ساكت وأنا ما بقدر أتنفس.
sentences.en: I stayed silent, unable to breathe.

sentences.ar: كنت بحبه، وهلق صرت بخاف منه.
sentences.en: I had liked him, and now I feared him.
